messages:
maya: Heads-up — found a broken gist in the Runtime guide under "SDK examples". The code example references `redwood-js@0.9` which is archived and the gist 404s.
sam: Ugh, thanks for spotting. Can you paste the link?
maya: https://gist.github.com/oldaccount/8f7e2c1 (shows 404) Also the snippet references `client.createStream()` which we no longer support.
leo: That page is high-traffic. We should replace the gist with inline snippet and mention the new sdk: `@redwood/inference-js@1.x`.
maya: Agreed. Quick patch idea — inline code block and short note about the SDK upgrade + add redirect for the old gist URL. I can PR a tiny change.
sam: Can you assign an owner? I'd like to add a small automated test to catch future broken external snippets.
maya: @leo do you own the runtime guide? If not, can you point to the current doc owner?
leo: I picked it up last quarter but haven't pushed edits yet. I can own this. @docs-bot can you add a task: "Runtime guide — replace broken gist and update SDK sample"?
docs-bot: Created task RG-421 in docs backlog (assignee: leo). :white_check_mark:
maya: Cool. For the snippet, propose replacing with:
```
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference-js';
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY });
const resp = await client.createCompletion({ model: 'redwood-1', prompt: 'Hello' });
console.log(resp.text);
```
sam: LGTM — small nit: use `createCompletion` instead of `generate` to match SDK v1 naming.
leo: Good catch. I'll make the PR, add a small unit test that fetches external URLs referenced in docs CI and flags 4xx.
maya: Thanks! If anyone else sees other gists or external snippets, please thread them here. :eyes:
sam: Filed a quick follow-up issue to add a linter rule for external 200 checks. link: https://go/repo/issues/1234
leo: PR will be up by EOD. :rocket:
